entities.name: Query LpxC/FabZ
observations: 438 aa soluble enzyme sequence with predicted N-terminal LpxC domain (PF03331, residues 6–274) and C-terminal FabA-like dehydratase domain (PF07977, residues 307–429).
Close reviewed homologs Q8KBX0, Q7MXT8, and Q8A015 show 37.9–39.7% identity and 98.4–98.9% query coverage.
Likely bifunctional activity: UDP-3-O-acyl-N-acetylglucosamine deacetylase and beta-hydroxyacyl-ACP dehydratase.

entities.name: UDP-3-O-acyl-GlcNAc deacetylation
observations: Hydrolyzes UDP-3-O-[(3R)-3-hydroxyacyl]-N-acetyl-alpha-D-glucosamine with water to UDP-3-O-[(3R)-3-hydroxyacyl]-alpha-D-glucosamine and acetate.

entities.name: Beta-hydroxyacyl-ACP dehydration
observations: Annotated as EC 4.2.1.59; Rhea RHEA:13097, with related mappings RHEA:9925 and RHEA:9945.

entities.name: LpxC/FabZ zinc dependence
observations: Reviewed homologs are annotated as zinc-dependent for the LpxC deacetylase activity; the query sequence contains the corresponding N-terminal LpxC family architecture.
Cofactor assignment is inferred from homolog annotations rather than directly measured for this sequence.
